install_boost_library_dependencies: run depinst.py to scan a Boost library and install its header dependencies as git submodules
scan_header_dependencies: scan a source file for boost include directives and extract module dependencies
scan_module_dependencies: scan a Boost module directory for all header dependencies across include, src, and test subdirectories
resolve_header_to_module: resolve a boost header path like boost/function.hpp to its corresponding module name
install_git_submodules: install a list of Boost library modules as git submodules using git submodule update --init
